title: MetaText Portable Bundle Manifest
description: Manifest file (manifest.json) inside a .metatext.zip portable archive containing a plain-text data file, its .metatext.jsonc sidecar, and an optional Shadow Git history repository.

^x-.description: Custom vendor or tool extension fields preserved across editors.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema URL for validation and editor completion.

sourceFile.description: Relative ZIP entry path to the primary data file under data/.

sidecarFile.description: Relative ZIP entry path to the sidecar metadata file under data/.

includesHistory.description: Whether the archive contains an embedded Shadow Git bare repository under history/. Defaults to false on export for privacy.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the bundle was first created.

createdBy.description: Name and version of the tool that created the bundle.
